Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

IS :6893 ( Part 4) - 1987 



Indian Standard 
PROFORMA FOR PURCHASE ( Reaffirmed 2001 ) 

SPECIFICATION FOR MACHINE TOOLS 

PART 4 VERTICAL TURNING AND BORING LATHES 

{First Revision) 



1 . Scope — Recommends the proforina for the preparation of purchase specification for vertical 
turning and boring lathes with table diameter up to 1 600 mm. It also gives essential information about 
the vertical turning and boring lathes and their accessories which will enable the user to assess the 
usefulness and suitability for requirements.

Note — While submitting of quotations, the following information shall be furnished by the manufacturers/

IS : 6893 ( Part 4 ) -1987 
APPENDIX A 

{Clause 2.18 (Note)] 

REPRESENTATIVE CAPACITY CHART FOR VERTICAL 
TURNING AND BORING LATHES 

Note — Manufacturer's/supplier's shall specify the basic information called for in the figure below: 




A — Table diameter 

B — Maximum distance, table top to turret/ram face 

C — Maximum distance under cross rail 

D — Maximum vertical travel of turret/ram 

£ — ' Maximum travel of cross rail 

F — Height of table top from ground level 

G — Side head travel, vertical 

H — Overall height 

J — Overall length ^ 

K— Overall width 

L — Maximum horizontal travel of side head post along the centre 

line of table 
M — Maximum and minimum distance between the side tool post and 

top of table 
N — Minimum distance between side tool post and table centre 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

The proforma for preparation of purchase specification for machine tools has been prepared to 
enable a prospective buyer to collect data from various manufacturers/suppliers for purpose of com- 
parison. This is meant to be sent out with an enquiry by the purchaser ^o that the manufacturers/ 
suppliers can fill in the data and s^nd it back to the purchaser to make the comparison easier for the 
purchaser. 

Reference is made to the following Indian Standards in this standard: 

Colours for ready mixed paints and enamels ( third revision ) 

Dimensions of three phase foot mounted inductiiDn motors ( third revision) 

Shank sections for single point turning and planing tools 

Dimensions for T-slots ( second revision ) 

Coolant pump for machine tools 

Spacing of T-slots ( second revision ) 

Degree of protection provided by enclosures for rotating electrical machinery 

( first revision ) 
Measurement ancl evaluation of vibration of rotating electrical machines 
Test chart for vertical boring and turning mills with table diameter up to 

1 600 mm 
Principles of mechanical guarding of machinery 
10988- 1984 Method of measuring noise from machine tools ( excluding testing in anechoic 

chamber) 

This standard was first published in 1973. The Committee responsible for the formation of the 
standard decided to revise the same based upon experience. In the present revision detailed require- 
ment of motors and coolant pump, and requirements for environment and safety aspects have also been 
included in the proforma.
